textRuns.value: rates each resident on a 0–6 scale based on activity in the last 30 days. Incidents (+2) and positive drug tests (+2) are weighted most heavily as they indicate immediate safety and recovery concerns. Missed house meetings (+1) and climbing arrears above two weeks' rent (+1) serve as early behavioral warnings. Residents with a score of 2 or higher are recommended for case manager follow-up.
